name: LookPilot
detailed_description:
LookPilot turns your webcam into precise, natural 6DoF head & eye tracking for PC games. Look around in games by moving your head and eyes—making flight, racing, trucking, space, and FPS titles feel more immersive without extra hardware.

Setup is quick: install, start tracking, launch your game. Most supported games recognize LookPilot immediately; a few require enabling head-tracking in the game once. Everything runs fully on-device with low CPU usage, works even with lower-quality webcams, and supports Windows and Linux (including games launched via Wine).

How It Works

LookPilot tracks head rotation and translation (yaw, pitch, roll + X/Y/Z) and eye rotation, then combines them into a final camera output according to your settings. Output is sent to games through standard head-tracking interfaces, so no plugins or hardware clips are required.

Key Features

6DoF Tracking: Head yaw, pitch, roll, plus forward/back, left/right, up/down translation.

Head + Eye Blend: Combine head and eye rotation with adjustable influence to match your preference.

High-Rate Output: Responsive output at high refresh rates for smooth camera control—even from low-FPS webcams.

Quick Start: Install → Start tracking → Launch the game. Most titles work instantly; some need a one-time in-game toggle.

Low Overhead: Runs on CPU—no dedicated hardware or GPU required.

Cross-Platform: Windows and Linux support, including titles launched through Wine.

Wide Compatibility: Works with 700+ games via standard head-tracking interfaces.

Keybinds: Recenter, toggle tracking, and switch presets on the fly.

Setup in Three Steps

1. Install & Launch: Open LookPilot and start tracking.

2. Start Your Game: Most games detect tracking automatically; if needed, enable head-tracking in the game’s options once.

3. Fine-Tune (Optional): Adjust smoothing, deadzones, mapping, and eye influence to taste.

Customization & Presets

Protocols: Choose the communication interface (useful on Linux or for power users).

Head Tracking Settings: Toggle axes; set input→output mapping per axis; tune smoothing, deadzones, and confidence threshold.

Eye Tracking Settings: Per-axis mapping and smoothing controls.

Blend Control: Adjust how much eye tracking influences the final output.

TrueView Toggle: Choose translation relative to mapped/output rotation or the real rotation.

Presets: Create unlimited presets, switch with keybinds, and share with others.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: A standard webcam is required (either built-in or external).
